grammar.title: Over and over with 反复
grammar.explanation: 反复 (fǎnfù) means "repeatedly, over and over again" — it describes an action done many times to make sure it's right. It goes right before the verb.

grammar.title: A whole, full amount with 整整
grammar.pattern: 整整 + 数量 + 量词
grammar.explanation: 整整 (zhěngzhěng) emphasizes that an amount is a full, whole quantity — "a whole..., a full...". It goes right before the number and measure word, stressing there's no less than that.

sentences.pinyin: Tā zhěngzhěng děng le sān gè xiǎoshí.
sentences.en: He waited a full three hours.

sentences.pinyin: Tāmen zhěngzhěng zǒu le yī tiān.
sentences.en: They walked for a whole day.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū zhěngzhěng yǒu wǔbǎi yè.
sentences.en: This book has a full five hundred pages.

sentences.zh: 请你反复练习这个句子。
sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ fǎnfù liànxí zhège jùzi.
sentences.en: Please practice this sentence over and over.

sentences.zh: 他反复检查了这份文件。
sentences.pinyin: Tā fǎnfù jiǎnchá le zhè fèn wénjiàn.
Wǒ fǎnfù xiǎng le zhège wèntí.
sentences.en: I thought about this problem over and over.
